iconicAnchor.label: Mutant Materials in Contemporary Design: Plastics
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: MoMA documents plastics as moldable, translucent, transparent, organic, detailed, and structurally varied materials rather than a single surface effect.

sources.title: Mutant Materials in Contemporary Design: Plastics
supports: Injection, blow, rotational, and cast processes give plastics distinct forms, transparency, detail, and structural behavior.

sources.title: Plastic
supports: Different polymer structures create varied visual and functional properties, while molding enables durable affordable consumer forms.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches rounded molded form, translucent color, glossy surface, frosted depth, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/candy-plastic/generated-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
